name: Ichinomiya Kotone
source: Joins in the heaven route. Master of the fire type guardian Gara. The more shy and reserved of the Ichinomiya sisters. Her powers don't work unless she is with her sister.
translation: Joins in the heaven route. Master of the fire type guardian Gara. The more shy and reserved of the Ichinomiya sisters. Her powers don't work unless she is with her sister.
